announcements.headline: NOTICE OF OPTIONAL FULL REDEMPTION
announcements.insight: SANTANDER UK GROUP HOLDINGS PLC has issued a notice of optional full redemption following its half-year report. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the redemption process.

announcements.headline: Notice of Optional Redemption in Full
announcements.insight: SANTANDER UK GROUP HOLDINGS PLC announces an optional redemption. This follows its half-year financial report from August 2026.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
